To be accepted as an honorary barbarian in Svargrond you have to pass three trials from {npc:Sven}: drink mead without passing out, hug a bear and knock down a mammoth. You earn a {item:Mead Horn}, the achievements **Bearhugger** and **Honorary Barbarian**, and you can become a citizen of Svargrond, travel with {npc:Buddel}, fight in the Svargrond Arena and start The Ice Islands Quest.

Takes you to the {wiki:Barbarian Settlements|barbarian camps}, to Okolnir and to Krimhorn; for Tyrsung you also need to have started the mission *Nibelor 2: Ecological Terrorism* of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest|The Ice Islands Quest}.
When you become an honorary barbarian: {npc:Sven} tells you about {npc:Iskan}, who has trouble with dogs.
{npc:Iskan}'s sled to Nibelor only takes you after this quest and the first mission of The Ice Islands Quest.
Bring several {item:Honeycomb|Honeycombs}: each one gives you only 20 sips to attempt the first trial.
Bring a {item:Dwarven Ring} for the mammoth trial: after drinking the 3 mugs you will be very drunk.

If you are not in **Svargrond**, take the boat from **Carlin**, **Thais** or **Venore** (tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city. Go to {npc:Sven}: **west of the depot** in Svargrond, turn **south** at the crossroads (it is a big building with lots of benches). Say {key:hi}, {key:barbarians}, {key:test}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. The first trial is to drink **at least 10 sips of mead in a row without passing out**, but you must bring your own honey.
With a {item:Honeycomb}, say {key:mead} and {key:yes}. For each honeycomb you get **20 sips** from the mead bucket.

Use the mead bucket repeatedly until you manage **10 sips in a row** without passing out. You can drink as fast as you can. When you pass a sip, *"The world seems to spin but you manage to stay on your feet."* appears; when you fail, *"The mead was too strong. You passed out for a moment."* appears (your character looks like a {creature:Dead Human|human corpse} for a few seconds). When you succeed, *"You already passed the test, no need to torture yourself anymore."* appears.
If you use up all 20 sips without succeeding, say {key:mead} and {key:yes} to Sven again with another {item:Honeycomb}. Repeat until you pass.
Say {key:hi} and {key:mead} to {npc:Sven}. He gives you a {item:Mead Horn (Empty)} and tells you to hug a bear in a cave north of the city.
Fill the {item:Mead Horn (Empty)} at the mead bucket behind Sven (brown contents).

The sleeping bear is north of Svargrond, 2 floors up, climbing some ramps **east** of the arena ramps (where the flying carpet man is). Go **west** and then **north**, past the carpet man, to a small ice cave. After the entrance to the big ice area, go **north** until you hit a wall and follow it **east**.
Location of the bear and the mammoth
Get the bear drunk and hug it
Use the {item:Mead Horn|full Mead Horn} on the bear to knock it out. Then **use the bear** to hug it. You earn the achievement **Bearhugger**.
The unconscious bear, ready to be hugged

Go back the same way: leave the ice cave, go down the ramps (2 floors) to city level and return to {npc:Sven}. Say {key:hi} and {key:hug} (or {key:bearhugging}). He tells you to take down a lone mammoth northwest of the city.
Buy 3 {item:Mug|mugs} of {item:Mead} from {npc:Dankwart}, near Sven. Empty mugs filled with {item:Beer} from the barrel under Sven also work.
The {item:Mammoth (Object)|mammoth} is in the same icy area as the bear, but further **west**.
In this area there are {creature:Winter Wolf|Winter Wolves}, {creature:Polar Bear|Polar Bears}, {creature:Penguin|Penguins} and {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}.
Stand in front of the mammoth, drink the **3 mugs** and then **use the mammoth** to knock it down.
You will get very drunk: put on a {item:Dwarven Ring} so you don't stagger.

Go back to the city the same way as from the bear (down the ramps 2 floors) and go to {npc:Sven}. Say {key:hi} and {key:mammoth}. You are now an honorary barbarian and earn the achievement **Honorary Barbarian**.
Honorary Barbarian achievement + access to Svargrond (citizenship, Buddel, Arena, Ice Islands Quest)
After this quest you can start {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest|The Ice Islands Quest}: Sven tells you about {npc:Iskan}, on the ice north of the city, who has problems with the dogs.
You can also fight in the arena for the {wiki:Barbarian Arena Quest|Barbarian Arena Quest}.
